test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 2p + q = 19 and 8p³ + q³ = 361, then find the value of pq.
solution:
Given:

2p + q = 19 and 8p3 + q3 = 361

Concept used:

a3 + b3 = (a + b)3 - 3ab(a + b)

Calculation:

8p3 + q3 = 361

⇒ (2p + q)³ - 3 × 2p × q (2p + q) = 361

⇒ (2p + q)3 - 6pq(2p + q) = 361

⇒ 193 - 6pq × 19 = 361

⇒ 19² - 6pq = 19

⇒ 6pq = 19² - 19

⇒ 6pq = 342

⇒ pq = 57

∴ The value of pq is 57.
